title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of the Spyglass tool, now fully upgraded and ready to empower you with powerful new insights and a seamless experience.

title: Empowered File Management in Your Editor
summary: Gain complete command over your embedded files with a new dedicated management area, enabling easy uploads, removals, downloads, and flexible visual customization right within your editor.

summary: Explore our new public roadmap page to easily track recent updates, upcoming features, and what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Our newly designed checkboxes offer effortless dragging, improved clickability, and a sleek, modern look for enhanced productivity.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a more intuitive and integrated way to work together with our enhanced real-time collaboration features, designed to boost team awareness and ease of use.

summary: Discover and organize your knowledge with ease through a significantly enhanced Constellation view, now equipped with dynamic filters to personalize your exploration.

title: Dynamic Note Views
